{'translation': 'Last week, following the release of Xcode 27.1 beta 1, Bitrig added support for building and testing iPhone Duo apps, equipped with an interactive 3D simulator that lets developers freely fold, tilt, rotate, and position the device. Details below.', 'translation_zh': '上週 Xcode 27.1 beta 1 發佈後，Bitrig 新增對 iPhone Duo 應用程式建置與測試嘅支援，並且配備一個可互動嘅 3D 模擬器，等開發者可以隨意摺合、傾斜、旋轉同擺放裝置。詳細內容如下。'}

{'translation': 'Bitrig users can now play around with a 3D iPhone Duo', 'translation_zh': 'Bitrig 而家用戶可以玩弄 3D iPhone Duo'}

{'translation': 'Bitrig first launched as a simple vibe-coding app that let users turn text or voice prompts into native SwiftUI apps that run right inside the Bitrig main app on iPhone.', 'translation_zh': 'Bitrig 最初係以一個簡單嘅 vibe-coding 應用程式登場，等用戶可以將文字或語音提示轉化成原生 SwiftUI 應用程式，直接喺 iPhone 上嘅 Bitrig 主應用程式入面運行。'}

{'translation': 'Since then, the platform has expanded significantly, adding Mac apps giving users access to the full Xcode toolchain, an integrated iPhone simulator, testing on real devices, and the ability to export projects to Xcode or publish apps via TestFlight and the App Store.', 'translation_zh': '自此之後，呢個平台大幅擴展，新增 Mac 應用程式畀用戶使用完整嘅 Xcode 工具鏈、整合式 iPhone 模擬器、實機測試，以及將專案匯出到 Xcode 或透過 TestFlight 同 App Store 發佈應用程式嘅功能。'}

{'translation': 'Last Friday, after Apple released Xcode 27.1 beta 1 with support for building and testing iPhone Duo apps, Bitrig rolled out its own iPhone Duo support, presenting the simulator in a more interactive way.', 'translation_zh': '上星期五，Apple 發佈支援建置同測試 iPhone Duo 應用程式嘅 Xcode 27.1 beta 1 之後，Bitrig 都推出自家嘅 iPhone Duo 支援，以更互動嘅方式呈現模擬器。'}

{'translation': "Here's Bitrig co-founder and CEO Kyle Macomber walking through what this update brings:", 'translation_zh': '以下係 Bitrig 聯合創辦人兼行政總裁 Kyle Macomber 講述呢次更新帶嚟嘅功能：'}

{'translation': "Try out the various postures. The iPhone Duo can sit on a desk like a laptop, or stand upright at the bedside like a monitor. Whether open, closed, or half-folded, landscape or portrait, your app needs to adapt. Bitrig's 3D simulator lets you pick it up, fold it, rotate it, and watch how your app responds. Respond to the hinge. Use onHingeChange to drive interactions and effects as the laptop folds, like Apple's unfolding effect, so the outer display feels like a window into the inner one. Read hinge data in real time as you open and close within the built-in simulator. Build hands-free experiences. When the iPhone Duo sits on a desk, use ArrangementView to put media content on the top half and controls on the bottom. Support landscape display so users can use your app on the outer display when the device is standing on its edge. Use both displays at once. Add CameraCaptureAccessory to the outer display so the person facing the camera has something to look at.", 'translation_zh': '嘗試各種姿態。iPhone Duo 可以好似手提電腦噉擺喺枱面，又或者好似營幕噉豎喺床頭。無論打開、合埋，或者半摺，橫向定直向，你嘅應用程式都要適應。Bitrig 嘅 3D 模擬器等你可以拎起佢、摺合佢、轉動佢，然後睇住你嘅應用程式點樣回應。回應鉸鏈動作。利用 onHingeChange 喺手提摺合嘅時候驅動互動同效果，好似 Apple 嘅展開效果，等外熒幕感覺好似內熒幕嘅一扇窗。喺內置模擬器入面打開合埋嘅時候實時讀取鉸鏈數據。打造免提體驗。當 iPhone Duo 放喺枱面時，使用 ArrangementView 將媒體內容擺喺上半部分，控制選項擺喺下半部分。支援橫向顯示，等用戶可以喺外熒幕上使用你嘅應用程式，當部機以邊緣企立嘅時候。同時使用兩個熒幕。喺外熒幕加入 CameraCaptureAccessory，等對住鏡頭嘅人有嘢睇。'}

{'translation': 'Macomber also noted: "Bitrig manages multiple versions of Xcode for you, so you can start using the beta to prepare your apps for iPhone Duo, and switch back to Xcode 27 to build and ship updates when you need to."', 'translation_zh': 'Macomber 亦提到：「Bitrig 幫你管理多個版本嘅 Xcode，等你可以開始用 beta 版為 iPhone Duo 準備你嘅應用程式，需要嘅時候又可以切返去 Xcode 27 建置同發佈更新。」'}
